hero.headline: Helping you find your fit in Charlotte.
hero.summary: Buying, selling, or relocating in the Charlotte area comes with a lot of decisions. As a REALTOR® licensed in North and South Carolina, I’ll help you make sense of the options, ask the questions you may not know to ask, and figure out what actually makes sense for your life.

about.workingStyle: Real advice. Smart guidance. No pressure.
about.headline: I’m not here to talk you into a house.
paragraphs: I’m here to help you make a good decision about one.

I’m Inga Draper, a Charlotte based REALTOR® licensed in North and South Carolina. I work with first time home buyers, sellers, and anyone relocating to the area, who want more than someone to just simply open doors.

We’ll talk about the house, of course. But we’ll also talk about the payment, the commute, how the location works for your everyday life, what may become expensive later, and whether the decision still makes sense once the excitement wears off.
Sometimes the right answer is “write the offer.” Sometimes it’s “this is not the one.” Both are part of the job.

services.headline: Real estate decisions should make sense beyond closing day.
services.summary: Whether you’re buying, selling, relocating, or thinking about what a property could become later, we’ll start with what matters to you and work forward from there.

items.title: Buying a home
items.description: We’ll figure out what you can comfortably buy, where your life works, and which homes actually deserve an offer. Then I’ll help you understand the numbers, risks, and contract before your money is on the line.

items.title: Selling a home
items.description: Before you spend money getting your home ready to sell, let’s decide what buyers are actually likely to care about. We’ll prioritize the updates worth doing, skip the ones that aren’t, and build a pricing and marketing plan around your home and your next move.

items.title: Moving to Charlotte
items.description: Charlotte is not one lifestyle. We’ll compare the homes, locations, commutes, routines, and tradeoffs that matter to you so you can narrow down where your life actually works.

items.title: Thinking beyond the purchase
items.description: Could this home work as a future rental? Should you keep your current house instead of selling it? Does the property support a bigger long-term plan? I can help you think through the questions worth answering before you make the move.
